name: Taimanin Asagi Gaiden ~Chaos Arena Hen~
original_name: 対魔忍アサギ外伝～カオス・アリーナ編～
source:
Asagi, who had been captured by Oboro, underwent a humiliating remodeling of her body, magnifying her sexual feelings thousands of times greater than that of a normal human being. Asagi's body trifled with, she is unable to control it by force of will alone. Thus, in the end for Asagi, Oboro has arranged her to participate as a combatant in the Chaos Arena, an organization of illegal martial arts.

When she loses, a disgraceful lynching awaits her, but how long can Asagi continue to fight, day in and day out, in the ring...!?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080818083218/http://www.darktranslations.com:80/projects/asagi-chaos-arena/]Dark Translations[/url] ]
translation:
阿莎姬落入胧手中，遭受了屈辱的身体改造。她对性刺激的敏感程度被放大到常人的数千倍。身体被这样摆弄过后，她光靠意志已经控制不住它了。最后，胧安排她到非法格斗组织混沌竞技场参战。

只要落败，等着她的就是一场当众受辱的私刑。日复一日地登上擂台，阿莎姬究竟还能打多久…？！

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080818083218/http://www.darktranslations.com:80/projects/asagi-chaos-arena/]Dark Translations[/url]]
